title: Warren Buffett: Bitcoin Is An Asset That Creates Nothing | CNBC
summary: In a CNBC interview with Becky Quick, Warren Buffett explains why he sees bitcoin as an asset that produces nothing. He contrasts it with productive assets such as a farm.
